name: Son La
note: Provincial city on National Highway 6 past Moc Chau. Northern Midlands and Mountains. Not a second Moc Chau page. Publish stays candidate. No public place file until the owner accepts it.

researchBase.note: Left out: a Vietnam Railways timetable, a 2026 Na San flight board, one bus fare, and one current drive time from Moc Chau to the city.

researchAttractions.note: Left out: a museum notice that chooses one hour and one fee, a plant visitor notice, a chosen dam distance, a chosen Pa Uon height, Ngu Dong Ban On because it sits on the Moc Chau plateau, and Hang Chi Day because the handbook gives no commune.

researchFood.note: Left out: market clocks, stall prices, a second be chao method, and duplicate dish files for com lam, pa pinh top, ruou can, and smoked meat because those slugs already exist on moc-chau.

researchNightlife.note: Left out: a bar street, a closing hour for ordinary nights, and which two Saturdays the city portal will post.

researchLifestyle.note: Left out: a named cafe street, and the hour the town goes quiet on a night when the walking street is dark.

researchContext.note: Left out: a 2027 civil date for the Le temple festival, which lunar window is current, drive minutes to Dien Bien Phu, and dossiers for Ta Xua, Yen Chau, and Hoa Binh.

destination.note: Place shell, seven interest groups, valley-day itinerary, three festivals. No attraction cards: dossier marks every sight unpublished, no licensed photo. No food guide, foodSlug, or Food chip. Check on arrival for disagreeing prison hours and tickets, the dam gate and a boat, Ban Mong soak, the stele, market clocks, stall prices, taxi and motorbike hire, the Hanoi fare, Moc Chau minutes, Pha Din, pass closures, 2027 festival dates, a Tet surcharge, and the Hmong day. Side trip placeholders: Dien Bien Phu, Ta Xua, Yen Chau, Hoa Binh. Place dot 4. Map pin 21.33, 103.91 is not in the dossier.

destinationCopy.note: Place prose and the valley-day line. No place hero: the dossier has no licensed photo of the walls, the town, and the Nam La in one frame. The page uses the highland cover. Both disagreeing figures stay. Unsourced fees and hours stay check on arrival.

destinationQuality.note: Read against the dossier. No hero and no sight cards, which matches the unpublished photos. Both figures stay for the prison, the dam, Pa Uon, Ban Mong, Highway 6, and the Le temple windows. Unsourced fees and hours say check on arrival. The map pin 21.33, 103.91 is not in the dossier. Festivals have no photo.
